name: Care-Beacon
description: Production RAG system answering patient cancer questions with paragraph-level citations. FastAPI + Next.js on Vercel, Qdrant Cloud vector search, Upstash Redis.

paragraphs: A production Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for answering patient questions about cancer using medical articles from BC Cancer, Canadian Cancer Society, and Cleveland Clinic. Provides accurate, cited answers with paragraph-level references.

Companion repository: Vital-Atlas is the upstream scraper that produces this system's corpus. Care-Beacon consumes Markdown and serves answers; it does no crawling of its own. See Where the corpus comes from.
features: Intelligent Question Answering - AI-powered responses with paragraph-level citations
Multi-Source Support - BC Cancer, Canadian Cancer Society, and Cleveland Clinic content
Source Filtering - Filter by cancer type or information source
Smart Caching - Redis (Upstash) caching to reduce repeated LLM/embedding costs
Vector Search - Semantic similarity using OpenAI embeddings and Qdrant Cloud
